data_issues: Label noise: in both fit and holdout, 25% of trials have a class label y that disagrees with the stimulus-log orientation_deg (y != orientation_deg/45), spread across all classes, i.e. labels were corrupted/shuffled for a quarter of trials. I treated orientation_deg as ground truth and retrained on labels derived from it (holdout accuracy improves vs. training on y).
